لعبة جماعية بجوال واحد أو أونلاين مع أصد: A group game on one phone or online with your friends (each from their own phone): everyone knows the word except one, so who is the impostor?
Choose the number of players, the category and the discussion time.
مرّروا الجوال؛ كل لاعب يكشف دوره سراً ثم: Pass the phone around; each player secretly reveals their role then hides it.
Ask each other questions about the word without mentioning it.
عند انتهاء الوقت صوّتوا ثم اكشفوا الدخيل: When time is up, vote then reveal the impostor.
اسأل أسئلة عامة لا تكشف الكلمة، مثل \"هل: Ask general questions that do not reveal the word, such as “Do you see it every day?”, as very specific questions give the word away to the impostor.
إن كنت الدخيل فاستمع للإجابات قبل أن تتك: If you are the impostor, listen to the answers before you speak, then answer in line with the consensus without too many details.
اجعل زمن النقاش بين دقيقتين وأربع حسب عد: Set the discussion time between two and four minutes depending on the number of players.
اللعبة أفضل مع أربعة لاعبين فأكثر، وفي ا: The game is best with four or more players, and in family sessions and on trips.
كيف تُلعب برّا السالفة؟: How is “Out of the Loop” played?
يمرّر اللاعبون الجوال واحداً واحداً، فير: Players pass the phone one by one, and each player secretly sees the secret word, except the impostor who sees that they are “out of the loop”. Then everyone discusses by asking questions about the word without stating it outright.
كم لاعباً نحتاج؟: How many players do we need?
From 3 to 12 players, and best from 5 to 8.
يفوز إذا لم يكتشفه الآخرون، أو إذا خمّن: He wins if the others do not discover him, or if he guesses the secret word after being exposed.
هل يمكن اللعب من جوالات مختلفة؟: Can we play from different phones?
نعم، أنشئ غرفة أونلاين وأرسل الرابط لأصد: Yes, create an online room and send the link to your friends; each player sees their role on their own phone, then you vote on the impostor.
هل تحتاج اللعبة إلى إنترنت؟: Does the game need the internet?
اللعب بجوال واحد يعمل دون اتصال. أما الغ: Playing on one phone works offline. The online room needs the internet.
كيف أغيّر الفئة؟: How do I change the category?
اختر فئة محددة أو \"عشوائي\" قبل بدء الج: Choose a specific category or “Random” before starting the round.
